turns.text: I want to build a browser extension that visualizes topic drift in ChatGPT conversations.
Start with a Chrome extension, a content script to extract transcript turns, and a local FastAPI backend for semantic analysis.
How should the UI show the main path versus rabbit holes?
Use a central rabbit trail for the dominant topic flow, lighter side branches for related detours, and broken hole nodes when the conversation sharply diverges.
We should also make the sidebar keyboard accessible and readable for demos.
Add focus states, keyboard navigation, and readable contrast, but keep the trail visualization as the hero surface.
Actually, how do regex capture groups work in JavaScript?
Capture groups let you save parts of a regex match so they can be reused later.
Back to the extension: how should clicking a node jump to the correct ChatGPT message?
Tag extracted transcript elements with stable turn ids, then scroll the matching DOM node into view when the sidebar node is selected.
